name: B10-0382/2025 (ECR) – Case of Abdoul Aziz Goma, arbitrarily detained in Togo
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Abdoul Aziz Goma, arbitrarily detained in Togo
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It condemns the detention of Abdoul Aziz Goma, a Togolese civil society actor held without proper legal process, and calls for his immediate release. It asks Togo to respect the rule of law, fair trials and access to lawyers. It also asks the European Union to press the case through diplomacy and to link its cooperation with Togo to human rights standards.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament asks Togo to release Goma and restore his rights.
- Goma and Togolese civil society are affected; Togo's government is urged to act.
- The European Union is asked to raise the case diplomatically and monitor it.
